# Corpus fixtures

Trimmed snapshots of real repositories of different shapes, used by
`tests/corpus.rs` to check that diagrams read the way a developer would
describe each codebase. Each keeps its license file.

| Fixture | Source | Commit | License |
|---|---|---|---|
| fastapi-template | github.com/fastapi/full-stack-fastapi-template (backend, scripts) | 7257e60 | MIT |
| httpx | github.com/encode/httpx (`httpx/` package) | b5addb6 | BSD-3-Clause |
| nanochat | github.com/karpathy/nanochat (Python and run scripts) | 92d63d4 | MIT |
| flask | github.com/pallets/flask (tutorial app, `signals.py`, `__main__.py`) | d086db8 | BSD-3-Clause |
| bakerydemo | github.com/wagtail/bakerydemo (project, settings, blog app) | c8f8255 | BSD-3-Clause |
| httpie | github.com/httpie/cli (entry points and CLI definition) | 5b604c3 | BSD-3-Clause |
